name: Income Certificate
description: An official certificate used to verify a person's annual family income for government schemes, scholarships, fee concessions, reservations, and other government services.
shortDescription: Official proof of annual family income used for government schemes, scholarships, and other citizen services.

eligibility.summary: Residents who require official verification of their annual family income.
criteria: Applicant should be a resident of the concerned state or jurisdiction.
Applicant should provide valid identity and address information.
Applicant may need to provide documents supporting the declared family income.
eligibility.residencyRequirement: Resident of the concerned state or applicable jurisdiction
eligibility.incomeRequirement: Income details may need to be provided and verified

benefits: Provides official proof of annual family income.
Can be used while applying for eligible government schemes.
Can support scholarship applications where income certification is required.
Can be used for eligible fee concessions and other government benefits.
Helps establish income eligibility when an official income document is required.

steps.title: Open the Official Portal
steps.description: Visit the official state e-District or Revenue Department portal applicable to the applicant.

steps.title: Select Income Certificate Service
steps.description: Find and select the Income Certificate service.

steps.title: Enter Applicant Details
steps.description: Provide the required personal, residential, and income-related information.

steps.title: Upload Documents
steps.description: Upload the required identity, address, income, and photograph documents.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.description: Review the information and submit the application through the official portal.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: The application may be verified by the appropriate authority.

steps.title: Receive Certificate
steps.description: After approval, the certificate can be obtained through the applicable official process.

fees.description: Nominal processing fee varies by state (usually ₹15 - ₹30).

renewal.description: Must be renewed annually as income changes.

applicationTracking.description: Can be tracked via the e-District portal using the application reference number.

offlineAvailability.description: Availability of offline application depends on the applicable state and local administration (Tehsildar office).

verification.verificationNotes: Information should be re-verified against the applicable official state portal before application.

name: Birth Certificate
description: An official record documenting the birth of a child, required for establishing age, citizenship, and identity.
shortDescription: Official proof of birth and age.

eligibility.summary: Every birth occurring in India must be registered within 21 days.
criteria: Birth must have occurred within the jurisdiction.
Parents must provide proof of identity and hospital discharge summary.

benefits: Establishes age and identity.
Required for school admission.
Required for obtaining Passport, Voter ID, and other documents.
Establishes citizenship.

steps.title: Hospital Registration
steps.description: Most hospitals automatically report births to the local municipal body.

steps.title: Visit Portal/Office
steps.description: Visit the CRS portal (crsorgi.gov.in) or local municipal office.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.description: Fill the form and submit hospital records and ID proofs.

steps.title: Verification & Issuance
steps.description: The registrar verifies records and issues the digitally signed certificate.

fees.description: Free if registered within 21 days. Late fees apply thereafter.

renewal.description: Lifetime validity.

applicationTracking.description: Via CRS portal or municipal website.

offlineAvailability.description: Can be obtained at local Panchayat or Municipal Ward offices.

verification.verificationNotes: Policies may slightly vary by municipality.

name: Domicile Certificate
description: A legal document proving that a person is a resident of a particular state, used to claim state-level quotas and benefits.
shortDescription: Official proof of state residency.

eligibility.summary: Must be a continuous resident of the state for a specified number of years (usually 10-15 years, varies by state).
criteria: Applicant must meet the state's minimum residency duration.
Parents' residency may apply for minors.
eligibility.residencyRequirement: Continuous residence for 10-15 years in the state

benefits: Required for state-level educational quotas (e.g., Medical/Engineering seats).
Required for state government job reservations.
Required for state-specific welfare schemes.

requiredDocuments.name: Address Proof (Ration Card, Voter ID, Electricity Bill)
Educational Certificates
requiredDocuments.purpose: To prove years spent in state schools

steps.title: Visit Portal
steps.description: Go to the state's e-District portal.

steps.title: Fill Form
steps.description: Select Domicile Certificate and fill in personal and residency details.

steps.title: Upload Documents
steps.description: Upload historical proof of residence.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: Local patwari/talathi verifies the physical residence.

steps.title: Issuance
steps.description: Certificate is approved and can be downloaded.

fees.description: Standard state portal processing fee.

renewal.description: Usually valid for life unless the person moves to another state permanently.

applicationTracking.description: Available via e-District portal.

offlineAvailability.description: Apply via CSC (Common Service Centers) or Tehsildar office.

verification.verificationNotes: Check exact residency year requirements per state.

name: Permanent Account Number (PAN) Card
description: A ten-character alphanumeric identifier, issued by the Indian Income Tax Department, essential for financial transactions and tax filing.
shortDescription: Mandatory ID for tax filing, banking, and high-value financial transactions.

eligibility.summary: Any individual, company, NRI, or foreign citizen doing business or paying taxes in India.
criteria: Must require a PAN for financial transactions, taxation, or identity proof.
eligibility.residencyRequirement: None (NRIs and foreigners can also apply)

benefits: Mandatory for filing Income Tax Returns (ITR).
Required for opening a bank account or Demat account.
Required for purchasing/selling property or vehicles.
Serves as a valid identity proof globally within Indian contexts.

steps.title: Visit NSDL/UTIITSL Website
steps.description: Go to the official portal for PAN application (Form 49A for Indian citizens).

steps.title: Fill Details
steps.description: Enter personal details, contact info, and parental details.

steps.title: e-KYC / Document Upload
steps.description: Complete digital KYC using compatible ID or upload scanned documents.

steps.title: Payment
steps.description: Pay the application fee online.

steps.title: Processing & Dispatch
steps.description: e-PAN is emailed in a few days, physical card is dispatched via post.

fees.description: ₹107 for Indian dispatch; approx ₹1,017 for foreign dispatch.

renewal.description: Lifetime validity. Reprint/Correction forms available if lost/changed.

applicationTracking.description: Via NSDL or UTIITSL using the 15-digit acknowledgement number.

offlineAvailability.description: Through PAN centers and TIN facilitation centers.

verification.verificationNotes: Verify latest fees on NSDL portal.

name: Indian Passport
description: An official travel document issued by the Ministry of External Affairs, certifying the holder's identity and citizenship for international travel.
shortDescription: Official document required for international travel and global proof of identity.

eligibility.summary: Any citizen of India by birth, descent, registration, or naturalization.
criteria: Must be an Indian Citizen.
Must not have criminal proceedings barring international travel.
eligibility.residencyRequirement: Must have an address in India for police verification
eligibility.educationRequirement: Class 10 pass required for Non-ECR (Emigration Check Not Required) category

benefits: Allows international travel.
Acts as the strongest proof of citizenship and identity.
Serves as address and DOB proof.

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of Address
requiredDocuments.purpose: To verify residence for Police Verification

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of Date of Birth
requiredDocuments.purpose: Age verification (Birth Certificate, Class 10 Marks card, etc.)

requiredDocuments.name: Documentary proof for any one of the Non-ECR categories

steps.title: Register on Passport Seva
steps.description: Create an account on the official Passport Seva portal.

steps.title: Fill Online Application
steps.description: Submit details for a Fresh or Re-issue of passport.

steps.title: Pay and Schedule Appointment
steps.description: Pay the fee online and book a slot at the nearest PSK/POPSK.

steps.title: Visit PSK
steps.description: Attend the appointment with original documents for biometrics and verification.

steps.title: Police Verification
steps.description: Local police verify applicant details and address.

steps.title: Dispatch
steps.description: Passport is printed and dispatched via Speed Post.

fees.description: ₹1,500 for normal 36-page booklet; ₹2,000 for 60-page. Tatkaal fees extra.

renewal.description: Must be renewed every 10 years for adults, 5 years for minors.

applicationTracking.description: Real-time tracking via Passport Seva portal or SMS.

offlineAvailability.description: Online application is mandatory; physical visit required only for biometrics.

verification.verificationNotes: Tatkaal processing reduces timeline to 1-3 days post-appointment.
